Report Description
ON OCTOBER 5, 2011, A REPUBLIC SERVICES TRUCK SUFFERED A MECHANICAL FAILURE RESULTING IN A HYDRAULIC FLUID RELEASE ONTO THE ASPHALT ROADWAY AND ALSO IMPACTED A NEARBY STORM DRAIN. APPROXIMATELY 7-8 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC FLUID WAS RELEASE AND APPROXIMATELY 1-2 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC FLUID WAS RELEASED TO A NEARBY STORM DRAIN. CONTRACTOR DISPATCHED AN ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR TO THE SITE TO PERFORM THE CLEANUP. THE ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR APPLIED GRANULAR ABSORBENTS TO THE IMPACTED ASPHALT ROADWAY, COLLECTED THE IMPACTED ABSORBENTS AND CONTAINERIZED THE WASTE FOR DISPOSAL. THE ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR ALSO UTILIZED A DRUM VACUUM TO COLLECT THE RELEASED MATERIAL FROM THE IMPACTED STORM DRAIN.

Lat/Long: 42.025745, -82.596208 (Approximated from premise)
Reported Sheen Size: 700 feet by 700 feet (area 11.25 acres)
SkyTruth Minimum Estimate: 12.03 gallons
Report Description///NEEC REPORT////PELEE ISLAND FERRY SERVICE ADVISES OF A DIESEL SPILL INTO THE WATER WHEN EMPLOYEES WERE REFUELING THE FERRY PELEE ISLANDER II / CFK3147 AT PELEE ISLAND FERRY DOCK LOCATED AT 90 ROBSON ROAD, LEAMINGTON ON. AT THE TIME OF THE CALL, HE HAD NO MORE INFORMATION REGARDING THE AMOUNT OF FUEL BUT MENTIONED IT WAS SUBSTENTIONNAL. BOOMS WILL BE INSTALLED TO CONTAIN THE SPILL. AT 18:30 ET, ON 28 MAY 2023, A DIESEL SPILL WAS REPORTED AT THE LEAMINGTON MUNICIPAL MARINA, 90 ROBSON ROAD, LEAMINGTON, ON. THE DIESEL SPILL IS FROM AN UNSPECIFIED SOURCE BUT IS BELIEVED TO HAVE BEEN CAUSED DUE TO IMPROPER REFUELING OF THE PELEE ISLANDER 2, A FERRY OPERATING OUT OF THE MARINA. IT IS UNKNOWN IF DGS WERE ONBOARD THE VESSEL, AND IT HAS SINCE DEPARTED THE MARINE. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT IS ON SCENE AND SETTING UP BOOMS TO CONTAIN THE PRODUCT AND WILL MOST LIKELY BE HIRING DG CONTRACTORS TO ASSIST IN REMEDIATION EFFORTS. THE AMOUNT OF DIESEL SPILLED IS UNKNOWN BUT IT IS CURRENTLY CONTAINED WITHIN A ROUGHLY 700 SQUARE FOOT AREA WITHIN THE MARINA. THE COAST GUARD HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE INCIDENT BY THE FIRE DEPARTMENT, AND TDG CONTACTS IN THE ONTARIO REGION ARE ALSO AWARE. THERE ARE NO KNOWN IMPACTS TO TRANSPORTATION AT THIS TIME.

AT THE TIME OF THE CALL, HE HAD NO MORE INFORMATION REGARDING THE AMOUNT OF FUEL BUT MENTIONED IT WAS SUBSTENTIONNAL. BOOMS WILL BE INSTALLED TO CONTAIN THE SPILL. AT 18:30 ET, ON 28 MAY 2023, A DIESEL SPILL WAS REPORTED AT THE LEAMINGTON MUNICIPAL MARINA, 90 ROBSON ROAD, LEAMINGTON, ON. THE DIESEL SPILL IS FROM AN UNSPECIFIED SOURCE BUT IS BELIEVED TO HAVE BEEN CAUSED DUE TO IMPROPER REFUELING OF THE PELEE ISLANDER 2, A FERRY OPERATING OUT OF THE MARINA. IT IS UNKNOWN IF DGS WERE ONBOARD THE VESSEL, AND IT HAS SINCE DEPARTED THE MARINE. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT IS ON SCENE AND SETTING UP BOOMS TO CONTAIN THE PRODUCT AND WILL MOST LIKELY BE HIRING DG CONTRACTORS TO ASSIST IN REMEDIATION EFFORTS. THE AMOUNT OF DIESEL SPILLED IS UNKNOWN BUT IT IS CURRENTLY CONTAINED WITHIN A ROUGHLY 700 SQUARE FOOT AREA WITHIN THE MARINA. THE COAST GUARD HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE INCIDENT BY THE FIRE DEPARTMENT, AND TDG CONTACTS IN THE ONTARIO REGION ARE ALSO AWARE. THERE ARE NO KNOWN IMPACTS TO TRANSPORTATION AT THIS TIME.

Skytruth Analysis
THE CALLER IS REPORTING AN AQUEOUS AMMONIA RELEASE AT THE FACILITY DUE TO A LOSS OF POWER. THE POWER OUTAGE CAUSED THE FACILITY TO SHUT DOWN. A MANUAL DRAIN VALVE ON A UNIT WAS CLOSED DURING SHUT DOWN, AND WAS NOT RE-OPENED FOR STARTUP. THE HUMAN ERROR OF NOT RE-OPENING THE VALVE CAUSED THE AQUEOUS AMMONIA SOLUTION TO FLOW ONTO THE ROOFTOP AND OVER INTO A STORM DRAIN THAT LEADS TO THE SUSQUEHANNA RIVER. THE VALVE WAS OPENED AND REDIRECTED TO THE FACILITY WASTE WATER TREATMENT. THE SOLUTION THAT WENT ELSEWHERE WAS SPRAYED WITH WATER HOSES AND DIRECTED INTO CHEMICAL DRAINS OR TO THE WASTE WATER TREATMENT.

IT APPEARED DARK WITH WELL DEFINED EDGES AND A SMALL POCKET OF SILVER HUE THAT MAY HAVE BEEN AN INDICATION OF RELATIVELY THICKER OIL. DUE TO THE CHARACTERISTICS DESCRIBED ABOVE, CONFIDENCE IN THIS REPORT IS HIGH. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGERY WERE OUT OF THE SSE AT APPROXIMATELY 5-10KTS.

INCIDENT DESCRIPTION TAKEN FROM A WEB REPORT////////FUEL LINE LEAK INSIDE CONCRETE TRENCH - BETWEEN A CONVAULT DIESEL FUEL AST AND AN INDOOR EMERGENCY GENERATOR. SMELL OF FUEL IN AREA BY PASSERSBY RESULTED IN OUR LOCAL RESPONSE. OBSERVATIONS INDICATE THAT SMALL AMOUNT OF FUEL LEAKED INTO CONCRETE TRENCH ONLY WHILE EMERGENCY GENERATOR WAS ACTIVELY RUNNING. GENERATOR OPERATED MOST RECENTLY ON FRIDAY, 3 AUG 07. LEAK MAY HAVE OCCURRED OVER AN UNDETERMINED AMOUNT OF TIME. RAIN EVENTS MAY HAVE OVERFLOWED THE TRENCH CAUSING SMALL AMOUNTS OF FUEL TO ENTER ADJACENT STORM CONVEYANCE DROP INLET. SMALL AMOUNTS OF FUEL WERE FOUND AT THE NEXT 4 DOWNSTREAM STORM DROP INLETS, BUT WERE NOT FOUND AT ANY OF THE DOWNSTREAM PIPE OUTFALLS, WETLANDS AREA, OR AT MOST DISTANT POINT AT PROPERTY BOUNDARY. STANDING WATER AT DOWNSTREAM LOCATIONS DID NOT HAVE A SHEEN.
